conviction_note: The Q3 2026 report is confirmed for Friday 2026-11-27, and VIGO has released every non-annual periodic report after the 17:00 Warsaw close. The scored window is therefore close 11-27 to close Monday 11-30, and the baseline's bmo window should carry about nothing. Q3 revenue (34.5m PLN, +48% y/y) has been public since 2026-10-14, so the one new line is margin. Q2 adjusted EBITDA was 8m on 34.7m of revenue, and Q3 revenue was flat on Q2, so a Q3 EBITDA of roughly 6-9m against 1.6m a year ago is arithmetic anyone can do. The bar for it is unsourced (Ipopema's FY2026E 25.8m implies about 7m a quarter in H2), so the lean is small. abs_move is 4.5 because EBITDA and net profit are genuinely new on a name trading about $100k a day. p_up is 54 because a strong y/y margin was paid only modestly at H1 (+1.2%). The findings sum (+0.4) and the scaled number (+0.36) agree.

already_public.what: Q3 2026 consolidated revenue 34.5m PLN (+48% y/y), 9M 88.5m (+35%), segment split (industrial 20.4m +130%, military 8.2m +35%, transport 2.3m -45%, semiconductor materials 2.0m -24%), order intake 117.3m, backlog 86.5m (+70% y/y), InfraRed Associates about 8.5m in Q3. Company estimate published after the close.
H1 2026 results: Q2 adjusted EBITDA 8m PLN (vs 0.6m), Q2 adjusted net profit 3.7m, H1 EBITDA over 11m. The stock rose 1.6% intraday on 2026-09-28 and gave most of it back.

HyperPIC/IPCEI grant agreement terminated by mutual consent. No advances were received, so nothing is repaid; R&D spend was expensed as incurred, so no impairment. The strategic-options review closed without a transaction.
Board member Piekarski interview: 'we have bounced off the worst period in results'; the matrix line is ready mid-2027, with first matrix revenue in H2 2027.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 EBITDA and net profit are unpublished. Expect EBITDA of about 6-9m PLN against 1.6m in Q3 2025, flat to slightly down on Q2's 8m (weaker semiconductor-materials and transport mix, stronger industrial). Mildly positive against y/y, neutral against q/q.
Capex on the matrix line is starting (the 63m ABB money), so free cash flow likely turns negative. This was expected and is funded, so it should be neutral.
VIGO gives no numeric guide. Q4 commentary (backlog conversion, lower R&D opex after the HyperPIC exit, China ban on materials) is unknown in sign. No guide change is expected.

findings.finding: Q3 margin is the one line not pre-released. Q3 revenue was 34.5m PLN, essentially equal to Q2's 34.7m, and Q2 delivered 8m of adjusted EBITDA. On a largely fixed cost base, Q3 EBITDA should land around 6-9m PLN against 1.6m in Q3 2025, a 4-5x y/y step-up. The mix is slightly worse than Q2 (semiconductor materials -24% under the China dual-use ban, transport -45%) and offset by industrial +130%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Next session after each after-close release (VGO.WA daily bars). Q1 2026, when adj. EBITDA beat Ipopema: +5.8%. H1 2026, when Q2 EBITDA of 8m vs 0.6m was a large y/y step: +1.2% (504 to 510 on 2026-09-28, intraday +1.6% faded). Q3 2025: -0.6%. Q1 2025: +0.8%. The Q3 2026 revenue estimate: +0.4% (566 to 568 on 2026-10-15). Margin surprises are paid modestly; revenue barely at all.
findings.original_quote: 'osiągnął w III kwartale 2026 34,5 mln zł skonsolidowanych przychodów, co oznacza wzrost o ponad 48% rok do roku' [generated 34.5m PLN of consolidated revenue in Q3 2026, up more than 48% y/y]. 'Sprzedaż w segmencie materiałów półprzewodnikowych wyniosła w III kwartale 2026 2 mln zł i zmniejszyła się o ok. 23%' [semiconductor-materials sales were 2m PLN in Q3 2026, down about 23%]. Q2 base, Parkiet 2026-09-28: 'Skorygowana EBITDA zwiększyła się do 8 mln zł z 0,6 mln zł' [adjusted EBITDA rose to 8m PLN from 0.6m] (https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45201291-rekordowy-kwartal-vigo-kurs-w-gore).
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is at 504, about 11% below its 570 close of 2026-10-02 and below the 510 it traded after the H1 print, with no ESPI explaining the slide. If a roughly 7m-a-quarter EBITDA run-rate were in the price, the post-revenue drift would not have been down. The name trades about 1,000 shares a day with one active modeller, so nobody publishes a Q3 EBITDA preview. Against that, the arithmetic is simple and the H1 step-up was paid only +1.2%, which is why this finding is small.
findings.independence: Management tone, from a different document: Piekarski, Parkiet 2026-11-10, 'Odbiliśmy się od najgorszego okresu w wynikach' [we have bounced off the worst period in results] (https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/art45470981-lukasz-piekarski-vigo-photonics-odbilismy-sie-od-najgorszego-okresu-w-wynikach). Ipopema's FY2026E adj. EBITDA of 25.8m implies about 7m a quarter in H2.

findings.finding: The HyperPIC/IPCEI exit (2026-10-23) carries no repayment and no impairment into the Q3/Q4 accounts, because all HyperPIC R&D was expensed as incurred. This removes the one-off write-down a reader might fear and points to lower R&D opex from Q4, which the release may quantify.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement (after the close, 2026-10-23 17:07) was followed by 564 to 556 (-1.4%) on 2026-10-26, as the end of the strategic-options review and of the PIC growth story outweighed the cost saving. No prior results-day test of an R&D cost cut on this name.
findings.original_quote: 'Dotychczasowe nakłady na rozwój technologii HyperPIC były na bieżąco ujmowane w rachunku zysków i strat jako koszty operacyjne działalności R&D, dzięki czemu w aktywach bilansowych nie figurują istotne wartości niematerialne i prawne związane z tym projektem. (...) zakończenie umowy nie wiąże się ze zwrotem środków, ani koniecznością dokonywania odpisów aktualizujących' [HyperPIC development spend was expensed as R&D operating cost as incurred, so no material intangibles sit on the balance sheet; ending the agreement involves no repayment and no impairment write-downs].
findings.why_not_priced: Public for a month, so most of it is priced. What is not is the size of the R&D run-rate that stops. If the market had credited a lower opex base, the stock would not have drifted from 556 to 504 since. Small, and toward zero.
findings.independence: ESPI 49/2026 (https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/163720,vigo-photonics-sa-49-2026-polubowne-rozwiazanie-umowy-o-dofinansowanie-projektu-hyperpic-w-ramach-mechanizmu-ipcei) and the Piekarski interview, which says the HyperPIC costs 'były na bieżąco uwzględnianie w wynikach spółki' [were recognised in results as incurred] (https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/art45470981-lukasz-piekarski-vigo-photonics-odbilismy-sie-od-najgorszego-okresu-w-wynikach). Both are company statements, so not independent of the company.
